notes.text: The Product Management minor provides specialized skill sets for students that they will apply to succeed in the workplace, regardless of their chosen profession. Students will learn to apply product leadership frameworks and utilize rapidly evolving product management tools and technologies, to facilitate effective processes among organizational stakeholders and cross-functional product teams.
notes.source_line: The Product Management minor provides specialized skill sets for students that they will apply to succeed in the workplace, regardless of their chosen profession. Students will learn to apply product leadership frameworks and utilize rapidly evolving product management tools and technologies, to facilitate effective processes among organizational stakeholders and cross-functional product teams.

notes.text: The minor signals to potential employers that the graduate is ready to lead and motivate teams in-person and virtually, facilitate complex decision-making among diverse groups and individuals across cultures, and guide the development, launch, and scaling of successful products and solutions to support the success of the organization. Students will gain exposure to the full product lifecycle including identifying product-market fit, leveraging data for strategic decisions, and managing stakeholder relationships to deliver meaningful business outcomes.
